summary: Re-tested the three P0/P1 frontend fixes from iteration 9. ALL PASS. (1) Tablet transparent-modal Settings: at 1024x768 the gear opens Settings as a right-side panel (x=545, w=479 ≈ 480px) with a dimmed backdrop on the left (x=0, w=544, rgba 0.35). Home content (FAB at x=948, note cards, drawer) is visible under the backdrop. Tapping settings-backdrop safely dismisses via router.back() with NO PAGEERROR — the previous 'router is not defined' crash is fixed by the new `useRouter()` hook in settings.tsx. (2) Narrow-screen Settings at 390x844 renders full-screen (panel width 390, x=0, no backdrop, no crash). (3) Handwriting toolbar is visibly compact — outer toolbar container is 60px wide, tool-pen button is 44x36 with icon 16 and label 9pt (verified via computed styles + screenshot). (4) Handwriting orientation & paper size are persisted correctly: created A4 landscape note → GET /api/notes/{id}.drawing_data = {orientation:'landscape', paperSize:'a4', paper:'blank'}. Created A4 portrait note → drawing_data = {orientation:'portrait', paperSize:'a4'}. Both test notes cleaned up (DELETE 200). Backend testing skipped per instructions.

critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx now uses `useRouter()` hook — good, matches Expo Router idiom and prevents the previous ReferenceError. Consider also swapping the hard-coded rgba(0,0,0,0.35) backdrop to a theme scrim token for consistency across themes.

React Native Web still logs benign 'shadow* style props are deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warnings on load (not caused by these changes). Non-blocking but noisy; can be addressed later with `boxShadow` and `style.pointerEvents`.
